Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Ingram
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/01/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 165 as introduced could reduce receipts to the State General Fund and the Secretary of State Entity Fund by $17.50 and $7.50, respectively, for each certificate of existence fee the Secretary of State elects to waive.
According to Secretary of State, the average annual distributions from these fees are estimated to be $265,000 to the State General Fund and $114,000 to the Secretary of State Entity Fund.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund

According to Secretary of State, the average annual distributions from these fees are estimated to be $265,000 to the State General Fund and $114,000 to the Secretary of State Entity Fund.

Governmental Affairs
